- [PREFERENCE] User is experiencing grainy shots in low-light photography.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A 50mm prime lens is versatile for low-light photography and can produce amazing results.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To minimize grain in low-light photos, understand the camera's ISO limitations, use a low ISO and compensate with shutter speed, and use a wide aperture.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for low-light photography include stabilizing the camera, paying attention to lighting, shooting in RAW, and practicing different techniques.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested considering a lens with image stabilization for frequent low-light shooting.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Post-processing is key for low-light photos, and tools like Lightroom or Photoshop can help reduce noise.
